purpose: Stop technically valid but confusing gameplay captures from reaching Kevin, the website, social channels or distribution partners.

moments.title: THE CREATURE HELPS
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: A visible danger or blocked route, the creature taking one unmistakable action, and the solved result in the same clean frame with no message box over the action.

moments.title: A CHOICE CHANGES SOMETHING
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: A short choice in plain words followed by a dramatic persistent change to colour, route, structure, weather or creature behaviour that is obvious with the words removed.

moments.title: A STRANGE DISCOVERY
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: One impossible alien phenomenon occupying the visual focus—living gravity, liquid memory, folded light, migrating geometry or another realm-specific behaviour—with the astronaut and creature visibly reacting.

moments.title: MOVEMENT FEELS ALIVE
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Six to ten uninterrupted seconds through a visually rich section containing readable terrain, one meaningful traversal action, environmental motion and the creature continuously present.

realmRecapture.meaning: A replacement realm capture should not hide a performance problem. The gameplay scene needs another iteration before it can become launch proof.

nextGate.request: Create four deliberately staged, still-authentic gameplay states that satisfy the nextCaptureMustShow directions and make the forest movement capture pass its sustained mobile budget.
